← examples

bhū sūktam

kṛṣṇa yajurvedīya

﻿﻿bhūmi̍r bhū̱mnā dyaur va̍ri̱ṇā'ntari̍kṣam mahi̱tvā ।

﻿﻿u̱pasthe̍ te devya-dite̱'gnima̍-nnā̱dama̱-nnādyā̱yā''da̍dhe ॥ 1॥


﻿﻿ā'yaṅ gauḥf pṛśni̍ra-kramī̱da-sa̍nan mā̱tara̱m puna̍ḥ ।

﻿﻿pi̱tara̍ñ ca pra̱yanth suva̍ḥ ॥ 2॥


﻿﻿tri̱ṁ̱gṁśad dhāma̱ virā̍jati̱ vāk pa̍ta̱ṅgāya̍ śiśriye ।

﻿﻿pratya̍sya vaha̱ dyubhi̍ḥ ॥ 3॥


﻿﻿a̱sya prā̱ṇāda̍-pāna̱t ya̍ntaś ca̍rati roca̱nā ।

﻿﻿vya̍khyan mahi̱ṣas suva̍ḥ ॥ 4॥


﻿﻿yattvā̎ kru̱ddhaḥf pa̍ro̱ vapa̍ ma̱nyunā̱ yada-va̍rtyā ।

﻿﻿su̱kalpa̍ma-gne̱ tat tava̱ puna̱s tvo-ddī̍payāmasi ॥ 5॥


﻿﻿yatte̍ ma̱nyu pa̍roptasya pṛthi̱vīma-nu̍ dadhva̱se ।

﻿﻿ā̱di̱tyā viśve̱ tad de̱vā vasa̍vaś ca sa̱mābha̍ranˎ॥ 6॥


﻿﻿mano̱ jyoti̍r juṣatā̱mā-jya̱ṁu vicchi̍nnaṁi
ya̱jñaṁgṁ sami̱-man da̍dhātu ।

﻿﻿bṛha̱spati̍s tanutāmi̱-man no̱ viśve̍ de̱vā | i̱ha mā̍dayantāmˎ॥ 7॥


﻿﻿sa̱pta te̍ | agne sa̱midha̍s sa̱pta ji̱hvās

﻿﻿sa̱pta | ṛṣa̍yas sa̱pta dhāma̍ pri̱yāṇi̍ ।

﻿﻿sa̱pta hotrā̎s sapta̱dhā tvā̍ yajanti

﻿﻿sa̱pta yonī̱rā-pṛ̍ṇasvā ghṛ̱tena̍ ॥ 8॥


﻿﻿puna̍rū̱-rjā ni va̍rtasva̱ puna̍ra-gna | i̱ṣā''yu̍ṣā ।

﻿﻿puna̍r naḥf pāhi vi̱śvata̍ḥ ॥ 9॥


﻿﻿sa̱ha ra̱yyā ni va̍rta̱svā-gne̱ pinva̍sva̱ dhāra̍yā ।

﻿﻿vi̱śvapsni̍yā vi̱śvata̱s pari̍ ॥ 10॥


﻿﻿leka̱s sale̍kas su̱leka̱s te na̍ | ādi̱tyā | ājya̍ñ juṣā̱ṇā vi̍yantu̱

﻿﻿keta̱s sake̍tas su̱keta̱s te na̍ | ādi̱tyā | ājya̍ñ juṣā̱ṇā vi̍yantu̱

﻿﻿viva̍svā̱ṁ̱gṁ| adi̍ti̱r deva̍jūti̱s te na̍ | ādi̱tyā | ājya̍ñ juṣā̱ṇā vi̍yantu ॥ 11॥


﻿﻿ma̱hīn de̱vīṁu viṣṇu̍patnīma-jū̱ryāmˎ।

﻿﻿pra̱tīcī̍me-nāṁgṁ ha̱viṣā̍ yajāmaḥ ।

﻿﻿tre̱dhā viṣṇu̍ru-rugā̱yo vica̍krame ।

﻿﻿ma̱hīn diva̍m pṛthi̱vīma̱-ntari̍kṣamˎ।

﻿﻿tac chro̱ṇai-ti̱ śrava̍ | i̱cchamā̍nā ।

﻿﻿puṇya̱ṁ̱gg śloka̱ṁi yaja̍mānāya kṛṇva̱tī ॥ 12॥


dha̱nu̱r dha̱rāyai̍ vi̱dmahe̍ sarvasi̱ddhyai ca̍ dhīmahi ।

tanno̍ dharāḥf praco̱dayā̎tˎ॥


﻿﻿॥ oṁ śānti̱ś śānti̱ś śānti̍ḥ ॥
